capabilities: Mirror the entire Readwise library into vault notes and sync changed highlights one-way
Authenticate with Readwise via OAuth and test the API access token
Customize frontmatter, header, and highlight templates using Nunjucks
Track notes by Readwise URL so filenames and internal links stay intact across syncs
Generate custom filenames from item metadata and clean up existing ones
extras: Carries a prominent upgrade warning: moving from 1.x to 2.x without the documented migration steps can create duplicate notes or break internal links. Detailed guides (setup, file tracking, templating, frontmatter) live in a wiki rather than the README.
intentEvidence: Download this plugin if you want to mirror your entire Readwise Library into Obsidian and sync modifications
problem: Obsidian's existing Readwise import only appends new highlights, so edits made to existing highlights in Readwise never reach already-synced notes.

relations.evidence: Both plugins exist for different use cases, so please read below to determine which best suits your needs.

summary: Readwise integration that mirrors an entire Readwise library into the vault and one-way syncs new and changed highlights into regenerated notes.
